اندهشت (form VII)
# اِنْدَهَشْتُ (indahaštu) /in.da.haʃ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْدَهَشَ (indahaša)
# اِنْدَهَشْتَ (indahašta) /in.da.haʃ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْدَهَشَ (indahaša)
# اِنْدَهَشْتِ (indahašti) /in.da.haʃ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْدَهَشَ (indahaša)
# اِنْدَهَشَتْ (indahašat) /in.da.ha.ʃat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
